about.title: About Stitch Store AI
about.heroSubtitle: We bring carefully curated fashion and wellness essentials to customers around the world.
about.story1: Stitch Store AI started with a simple idea: online shopping should feel personal. We work directly with independent makers and trusted mills to bring you pieces that last — in fabric, in fit and in style.
about.story2: Today we serve tens of thousands of customers across more than thirty countries, with free shipping, easy returns and a support team that actually answers.
about.value1Desc: Real people, real answers, around the clock.
about.value4Desc: Every product is hand-picked and tested.

returns.title: Returns & Exchanges
returns.intro: We want you to love your purchase. If something isn't right, this policy explains how to return or exchange items bought from Stitch Store.
returns.eligibilityIntro: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery if all of the following apply:
returns.eligibility1: The item is unused, unwashed and free of damage or alteration.
returns.eligibility2: Original tags, packaging and accessories are intact.
returns.eligibility3: The order was placed directly through our store.
returns.eligibility4: A valid order number or proof of purchase is provided.
returns.nonReturnableIntro: For hygiene and safety reasons, the following cannot be returned or exchanged:
returns.nonReturnable1: Innerwear, swimwear and socks that have been unsealed.
returns.nonReturnable2: Personal care, wellness and fragrance products that have been opened.
returns.step1Desc: Email support{'@'}stitch.store or use the contact form with your order number and the reason for the return.
returns.step2Desc: Within 1 business day we'll confirm eligibility and send a prepaid return label (or return instructions for your region).
returns.step3Desc: Pack the item in its original packaging and drop the parcel at any carrier point within 14 days of approval.
returns.step4Desc: Once the return passes inspection, refunds are issued to the original payment method and exchanges ship immediately.
returns.refundBody: Approved refunds are processed within 3–5 business days after the returned item is received and inspected. Bank or card issuers may take up to 10 additional business days to post the credit. Original shipping fees are refunded only when the return is due to our error or a defective item.
returns.exchangeBody: Size and color exchanges are free when the requested variant is in stock. If it isn't, we'll hold your request for up to 14 days or convert it to a refund — your choice. Gift recipients may exchange any eligible item without the original purchaser present.
returns.shippingBody: Returns due to a defective or wrongly shipped item: we cover shipping. Returns for change of mind: a flat $5 return label fee is deducted from the refund. Some regions offer free return drop-off — we'll tell you when confirming your request.
returns.damagedBody: Please report damaged, defective or incorrect items within 7 days of delivery with a photo. We'll ship a replacement right away — no need to wait for the original item to come back.
returns.faq1Q: How long do I have to return an item?
returns.faq1A: 30 days from the delivery date, provided the item meets the eligibility conditions above.
returns.faq2Q: Do I need the receipt or order number?
returns.faq2A: Yes. The order number (from your confirmation email) is the fastest way to verify your purchase. Without it we can still help, but processing takes longer.
returns.faq3A: Absolutely. Use the gift order number or contact us with the item name, and we'll issue the refund as store credit to the gift recipient.
returns.faq4Q: When will I receive my refund?
returns.faq4A: 3–5 business days after inspection, plus up to 10 business days depending on your bank. You'll get an email the moment it's issued.
returns.faq5Q: Can I cancel an order instead?
returns.faq5A: Orders can be cancelled free of charge within 2 hours of purchase, before they are dispatched. After dispatch, please use the return process.
returns.contactBody: Our support team replies within 24 hours on business days.
